title: Void Pack
description: This project adds a low-graphics CPvP-focused resource pack with better FPS and improved textures for most PvP items.
body:
Void Pack is a lightweight PvP resource pack focused on Crystal PvP (CPvP) performance and visibility. It features a simplified low-graphics style to improve FPS and reduce visual clutter during fights.

Features Better FPS and smoother gameplay Reduced graphics for improved performance Enhanced textures for most PvP-related items Clean and simple visuals optimized for CPvP Easier visibility in fast-paced combat Lightweight and competitive-focused design

This pack is made for players who want maximum performance and a cleaner combat experience without unnecessary details.

-use Skyboxify to render the custom sky
